method.band_time: count of 1 Hz samples with non-null watts >= band; minutes = count/60
method.sustained: within contiguous runs (time step == 1 s, watts non-null, zeros kept): greedy non-overlapping; start sample >= 280 W; furthest end with mean >= 280 W; trailing samples < 280 W trimmed; keep if duration >= 480 s
method.weeks: ISO weeks (Mon-Sun), clipped to the period window
method.lap_recompute: lap window = [FIT lap start_time - activity start_date, + FIT total_elapsed_time), stream mean over non-null watts
method.work_lap_rule: 240-600 s and stream mean >= 280 W (analyst rule)
